# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 2 tokens; Text — 3 tokens; Borders and rings — 1 token; Palette ramps and brand — 5 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 7 tokens; Radius — 3 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the paper theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--paper, #f7f7f4);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="sumi" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the sumi column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--paper, #121316);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #f7f7f4;
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | paper | sumi | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--paper` | #f7f7f4 | #121316 | The page. The writing surface and the app ground. It stays almost empty. |
| `--paper-raised` | #ffffff | #1b1c20 | Things that sit on the page: inline diagrams, tables, prototypes, the context tray. |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the paper theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--ink, #16171a);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="sumi" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the sumi column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--ink, #f2f1ec);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #16171a;
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | paper | sumi | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--ink` | #16171a | #f2f1ec | Settled text: anything Phlo has organized onto the page. Headings, body and the wordmark's counter-ink. |
| `--ink-muted` | #66665f | #9d9c95 | Metadata, mono labels, running headers, timestamps. 4.5:1 or better on paper in both themes. |
| `--ink-wet` | #b9b9b2 | #55554f | Speech that has not settled yet: live words on their way into the document. Intentionally below 4.5:1 because it is transient and turns into ink within a second. Never use it for text that stays. |

## Color · Borders and rings

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the paper theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--hairline, #e4e4df);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="sumi" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the sumi column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--hairline, #2a2b30);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #e4e4df;
```

### Tokens (1)

| token | paper | sumi | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--hairline` | #e4e4df | #2a2b30 | Rules, table lines and dividers. Use borders, not shadows. Decorative only, never a control's only edge. |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the paper theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--vermilion, #e5432a);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="sumi" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the sumi column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--vermilion, #ff5b3d);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #e5432a;
```

### Tokens (5)

| token | paper | sumi | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--vermilion` | #e5432a | #ff5b3d | The voice. The live mic dot, the wordmark's lead stripe, the recording state. One vermilion thing on screen at a time. For marks and large type only, never small text. |
| `--cobalt` | #2848d8 | #6683ff | Theme color 1 and the wordmark's second stripe. Earned: shows up only once ideas cluster. Also links and focus rings. |
| `--teal` | #13a38a | #33c7ac | Theme color 2. Marks, tab flags and chart series. Not for text on paper. |
| `--saffron` | #f2b01e | #ffc340 | Theme color 3. Marks, tab flags and chart series. Ink text sits on it, never white. |
| `--tab` | #5cc9e9 | #6fd4ef | The sticky-tab color: Phlo touched this. Callouts the AI pulled out, agent results, flagged ideas. Ink text on it. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 400 64px/64px "Geist", "Helvetica Neue", system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.035em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-display); letter-spacing: -0.035em;
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display` | `.display`, `--text-display` | 64px / 64px, letter-spacing -0.035em | 400 | `sans` | Covers and empty states. One per screen. |
| `title` | `.title`, `--text-title` | 40px / 44px, letter-spacing -0.025em | 400 | `sans` | Document title. Regular weight, never bold: size carries it. |
| `heading` | `.heading`, `--text-heading` | 20px / 28px, letter-spacing -0.01em | 500 | `sans` | Section headings Phlo creates as it organizes. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 16px / 26px | 400 | `sans` | Everything you said, settled. |
| `small` | `.small`, `--text-small` | 14px / 20px | 400 | `sans` | Table cells, captions, UI text. |
| `label` | `.label`, `--text-label` | 11px / 16px, letter-spacing 0.08em | 500 | `mono` | Uppercase running headers, section numbers, states. Set text-transform: uppercase. |
| `meta` | `.meta`, `--text-meta` | 12px / 18px, letter-spacing 0.02em | 400 | `mono` | Timestamps, transcript time codes, source counts. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `"Geist", "Helvetica Neue", system-ui, sans-serif` |
| `mono` | `--font-mono` | `"Geist Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (7)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Icon-to-label gaps, type nudges. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Inside tabs and chips. |
| `--space-3` | 16px | Between list items and blocks in a section. |
| `--space-4` | 24px | Between a heading and its first block. |
| `--space-5` | 48px | Between sections. The default breath. |
| `--space-6` | 72px | Page side margins at desktop. |
| `--space-7` | 120px | Above the title and around covers. Ma: the empty space carries weight. |

## Radius

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--radius-sm: 2px) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--radius-sm), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--radius-sm` | 2px | Sticky tabs and table cells. Paper-cut corners. |
| `--radius-md` | 8px | Raised blocks: diagrams, prototypes, the context tray. |
| `--radius-full` | 999px | The voice dot, pills, theme marks. |
